subject: afi-2
title: AFI(2)--------ATTN.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 394 (JR-16). AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree) is the subject; ATTN (attraction) is the partner. The title names AFI(2); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: TRS (transition), RT-DY (reality dynamics) and INFO-DOC (information documentation). From TRS: SOC-RT-DEVL. From RT-DY: SPT-GH (spiritual growth) and STY (style). From INFO-DOC: POL-DY (political dynamics). From SOC-RT-DEVL: SG (source initiation). From SPT-GH: WO-UNF (world unification). From POL-DY: REL-APC (relevant application).
